open Real

lemma integral_x_log_x :
    ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x * Real.log x = -1/4 := by
  set F := λ x : ℝ => x^2/2 * Real.log x - x^2/4 with hF
  have hFderiv (x : ℝ) (hxpos : x > 0) : HasDerivAt F (x * Real.log x) x := by
    dsimp [F]
    have h_deriv_sq : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2/2) (x) x := by
      have := hasDerivAt_pow 2 x
      have htemp : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2) (2*x) x := by
        simpa [pow_one] using this
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using htemp.const_mul (1/2 : ℝ)
    have h_deriv_log : HasDerivAt Real.log (1/x) x :=
      hasDerivAt_log (hxpos.ne.symm)
    have h_prod : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2/2 * Real.log t) (x * Real.log x + (x^2/2) * (1/x)) x :=
      HasDerivAt.mul h_deriv_sq h_deriv_log
    have h_simp : x * Real.log x + (x^2/2) * (1/x) = x * Real.log x + x/2 := by
      field_simp [hxpos.ne.symm]
      ring
    have h_prod' : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2/2 * Real.log t) (x * Real.log x + x/2) x := by
      simpa [h_simp] using h_prod
    have h_deriv_last : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2/4) (x/2) x := by
      have := hasDerivAt_pow 2 x
      have htemp : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2) (2*x) x := by
        simpa [pow_one] using this
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using htemp.const_mul (1/4 : ℝ)
    have h_sub : HasDerivAt (λ t : ℝ => t^2/2 * Real.log t - t^2/4) ((x * Real.log x + x/2) - (x/2)) x :=
      HasDerivAt.sub h_prod' h_deriv_last
    simpa [sub_add_cancel] using h_sub
  sorry
